notes.text: Heilprin’s combined Ravina dossier explicitly distinguishes earlier and later candidates. The checked encounters preserve the cited speakers, patronymics and rival identification arguments.
Be’er Sheva 11:4–6 acknowledges Tosafot, distinguishes two answers, and gives an explicit Sanhedrin exception. Bava Metzia juxtaposes the rulings, while the other three folios have direct address.

The cited Maginnei Shelomoh text was located. The Ran names Rava in the parallel Kiddushin passage, while the Ketubbot headword has Rabbah. Milhamot discusses whether Ravina accepted a particular legal position.
The short source-local holds preserve missing or ambiguous dialogues and the uncollated Yuhasin attribution. Neither adjacent names nor a single matching patronymic establish an identity.
